method.prefix_cache: none (each question is a fresh prefill, as --disable-radix-cache)
method.logits: answer position only (backbone over the prompt, then the LM head on the last position); max |Δlogit| vs the full call 0.125 on a 2,800-token prompt, from quantised matmul kernels
method.server: packages/arena/open-decisions/server.py, one request at a time

not_used: No Jev output was used to train, select or tune anything.

sglang.latency: round trip from the Mac through a coder port-forward tunnel; SGLang reports no server time
sglang.note: FlashInfer's JIT failed on the box (system nvcc lacks --compress-mode=size), so attention is Triton.
sglang.prompt_parity: prompt token ids from return_prompt_token_ids identical to server.py on a yes/no and a choice question
